info.title: API.SH: Zomato
info.description: The Zomato API from API.SH: public Zomato data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Zomato's handpicked collections for a city: id, name, number of places, description, cover image, link and listing path; pass the path to /zomato/v1/restaurants (`path=`) to list a collection's restaurants.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zomato-collections

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Zomato city slug (ncr, mumbai, bangalore, pune, hyderabad, dubai ...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Zomato restaurant by link: name, cuisines, overall, dining and delivery ratings with review counts, locality, address, city, country, position, phone numbers, chain link, delivery-only flag, currency, safety features, and the full delivery menu (menus, categories and items with description, price, price range, item rating and votes, dietary and service tags, serving size, availability, image and variants with prices). Also `photos` (the restaurant's header photos: id, image, thumbnail, uploader, date, likes, comments) and `has_more_photos`. `photos_page` and/or `photos_category` add `gallery`: one page of 30 photos of the full gallery with the tab counts (one more page read).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zomato-restaurant

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A zomato.com restaurant link, e.g. `https://www.zomato.com/ncr/haldirams-connaught-place-new-delhi` (the /order, /info or /menu forms work too).

parameters.name: photos_page
parameters.description: Gallery page (30 photos a page) to add as `gallery`; one more page read.

parameters.name: photos_category
parameters.description: Gallery tab to add as `gallery`: `all`, `food`, `ambience` (or another tab the gallery lists in `gallery.tabs`); one more page read.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Restaurants of a Zomato listing for a city (delivery, dining out or nightlife), a locality, a dish or a cuisine, or any zomato.com listing path. Each restaurant: id, name, overall, dining and delivery ratings with review counts, cuisines, cost for two and for one, locality and address, delivery time, serviceable and online-ordering flags, distance, promoted flag, offer, image and link. `total` is the listing's size; narrow it with `locality`, `dish` or `cuisine`. About 9-12 restaurants per page: pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` (alone) for the next page; null on the last page. Narrow by the site's rating floor (`rating_min`) and its Pure Veg filter (`pure_veg`); `applied_filters` then lists the filters the listing applied, and later pages keep them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zomato-restaurants

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Zomato city slug, e.g. `ncr` (Delhi NCR), `mumbai`, `bangalore`, `pune`, `dubai`. Give this or `path`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Listing type for the city (default delivery).

parameters.name: dish
parameters.description: Delivery restaurants serving a dish, as its slug, e.g. `biryani`, `pizza`.

parameters.name: locality
parameters.description: Restaurants in a locality, as its slug, e.g. `connaught-place-delhi`.

parameters.name: cuisine
parameters.description: Restaurants of a cuisine, as its slug, e.g. `chinese`, `north-indian`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Any zomato.com listing path or link, e.g. `/ncr/delivery/dish-biryani`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (then no other parameter is needed).

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Only restaurants rated at least this: 3.5, 4, 4.5 or 5.

parameters.name: pure_veg
parameters.description: true for pure vegetarian restaurants only.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A restaurant's Zomato reviews by link: rating and rating label, review text, date, experience (dining or delivery), reviewer name, link, review count and followers, likes, comment count, photos, tags and link, with the restaurant's total review count. Sort by newest, oldest, highest or lowest rating. 5 reviews per page: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zomato-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A zomato.com restaurant link, e.g. https://www.zomato.com/ncr/haldirams-connaught-place-new-delhi.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), oldest, highest or lowest rating first.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Zomato's search box for one city: restaurants (and chain outlets) whose name or dish matches, with id, name, rating, dining and delivery ratings and review counts, cuisines, cost for two and for one, locality and address, today's timing, table booking, a link to all outlets of a chain, image and link; feature suggestions (such as a collection or attribute) come back with their own type. For a full listing of a city, locality, cuisine or dish use /zomato/v1/restaurants.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zomato-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Restaurant name or dish.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Zomato city slug (ncr, mumbai, bangalore, pune, hyderabad, chennai, kolkata, dubai ...).

parameters.name: city_id
parameters.description: Zomato's numeric city id, for a city not listed under `city`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
